signals.name: No Capacity Management
signals.description: The entity does not maintain, monitor, and evaluate current processing capacity and use of system components to manage capacity demand and enable implementation of additional capacity to help meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: Infrastructure capacity planning, resource monitoring

metadata.detection_notes: Review infrastructure monitoring tools, capacity planning documentation, resource utilization metrics, and scaling policies. Check for absence of capacity thresholds, alerts, or proactive capacity management processes.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Availability
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: Capacity Planning Process Missing
signals.description: The organization has not established a formal capacity planning process. This signal indicates the absence of procedures for monitoring and projecting system capacity needs to ensure availability.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations with availability requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing capacity planning documentation, examining monitoring configurations, and verifying that capacity projections are performed.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Availability
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Environmental Protections and Recovery Infrastructure
signals.canonical_name: No Environmental Protections and Recovery Infrastructure
signals.description: The entity does not authorize, design, develop or acquire, implement, operate, approve, maintain, and monitor environmental protections, software, data backup processes, and recovery infrastructure to meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: Disaster recovery, backup systems, environmental controls

metadata.detection_notes: Review backup policies, disaster recovery plans, environmental controls documentation, redundant infrastructure, and recovery point/time objectives. Check for absence of backup systems, environmental monitoring, or recovery infrastructure.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Availability
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Recovery Testing
signals.description: The entity does not test recovery plan procedures supporting system recovery to meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: DR testing, backup restoration testing, BCP exercises

metadata.detection_notes: Review disaster recovery test schedules, backup restoration logs, tabletop exercise documentation, and test results. Check for absence of recovery testing, outdated test results, or incomplete test scenarios.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Availability
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Anomaly Detection and Analysis
signals.description: The entity does not monitor system components and the operation of those components for anomalies that are indicative of malicious acts, natural disasters, and errors affecting the entity's ability to meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: SIEM, security monitoring, log analysis

metadata.detection_notes: Review security monitoring capabilities, SIEM implementations, log analysis processes, and anomaly detection mechanisms. Verify continuous monitoring and alerting for abnormal activities.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Board Independence and Oversight
signals.description: The board of directors does not demonstrate independence from management and does not exercise oversight of internal control development and performance.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when the board lacks independent members, does not meet regularly to review controls, fails to challenge management on control decisions, or does not have expertise in risk management and internal controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Review board composition and independence criteria, board meeting minutes, audit committee charter, evidence of board oversight of control environment, and documentation of board challenges to management decisions. Look for absence of independent directors, infrequent meetings, or lack of internal control discussions.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC1 Control Environment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No External Threat Protection
signals.description: The entity does not implement logical access security measures to protect against threats from sources outside its system boundaries.
signals.applicability: Firewalls, network security, boundary controls

metadata.detection_notes: Review network architecture, firewall configurations, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and boundary protection mechanisms. Verify perimeter security controls are in place and properly configured.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Change Impact Assessment
signals.description: The entity does not identify and assess changes that could significantly impact the system of internal control.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when changes to systems, processes, or the business environment are not assessed for control impacts, change management processes are absent, or control updates are not triggered by significant changes.

metadata.detection_notes: Review change management procedures, control impact assessments for changes, documentation of business model changes, technology changes, regulatory changes, and evidence that controls are updated in response to changes. Look for absence of change impact assessments or controls not updated after significant changes.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC3 Risk Assessment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Infrastructure and Software Change Management
signals.canonical_name: No Infrastructure and Software Change Management
signals.description: The entity does not authorize, design, develop or acquire, configure, document, test, approve, and implement changes to infrastructure, data, software, and procedures to meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: Change control processes, software development lifecycle

metadata.detection_notes: Review change management processes, change request documentation, approval workflows, testing procedures, and deployment controls. Verify changes are authorized, tested, and documented.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC8 Change Management
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Commitment to Competence
signals.description: The entity does not demonstrate commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent individuals in alignment with objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when hiring processes do not assess competence, training and development programs are absent or inadequate, succession planning is missing, or retention of skilled personnel is not prioritized.

metadata.detection_notes: Review job descriptions with required competencies, hiring criteria, onboarding programs, training records, performance evaluations, succession plans, and turnover rates. Look for absence of competency requirements, lack of training programs, or high turnover in critical roles.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC1 Control Environment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Accountability for Internal Control
signals.description: The entity does not hold individuals accountable for their internal control responsibilities in pursuit of objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when control responsibilities are not assigned, performance measures do not include control effectiveness, consequences for control failures are absent, or there is no monitoring of individual accountability for controls.

metadata.detection_notes: Review control ownership assignments, performance objectives including control responsibilities, incident response records showing accountability actions, and evidence of consequences for control failures. Look for absence of assigned control owners, lack of performance metrics tied to controls, or no consequences for control deficiencies.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC1 Control Environment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Ongoing and Separate Evaluations
signals.description: The entity does not select, develop, and perform ongoing and/or separate evaluations to ascertain whether the components of internal control are present and functioning.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when control monitoring is not performed, control testing is absent, internal audits are not conducted, or there is no evidence of evaluating control effectiveness.

metadata.detection_notes: Review control monitoring procedures, control testing schedules and results, internal audit plans and reports, management self-assessments, and evidence of ongoing control evaluations. Look for absence of control testing, lack of monitoring activities, or no evidence of control effectiveness evaluations.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC4 Monitoring Activities
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Selection and Development of Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Selection and Development of Controls
signals.description: The entity does not select and develop control activities that contribute to the mitigation of risks to the achievement of objectives to acceptable levels.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when controls are not designed based on risk assessments, control selection is arbitrary, controls do not address identified risks, or there is no methodology for control design and implementation.

metadata.detection_notes: Review risk assessment to control mapping, control design documentation, evidence that controls address identified risks, and control selection methodology. Look for absence of risk-based control design, controls not aligned to risks, or ad-hoc control implementation.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC5 Control Activities
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Communication of Deficiencies
signals.description: The entity does not evaluate and communicate internal control deficiencies in a timely manner to those parties responsible for taking corrective action.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when control deficiencies are not identified, deficiencies are not communicated to responsible parties, remediation is not tracked, or there is no escalation process for significant deficiencies.

metadata.detection_notes: Review deficiency tracking systems, deficiency communication records, remediation plans, escalation procedures, and evidence of timely communication to management and board. Look for untracked deficiencies, lack of communication processes, or delayed remediation without proper escalation.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC4 Monitoring Activities
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Security Event Evaluation
signals.description: The entity does not evaluate security events to determine whether they could or have resulted in a failure to meet its objectives (security incidents).
signals.applicability: Security event triage, incident classification

metadata.detection_notes: Review security event triage processes, incident classification procedures, and event evaluation workflows. Verify that security events are assessed and escalated appropriately.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No External Communication
signals.description: The entity does not communicate with external parties regarding matters affecting the functioning of internal control.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when there is no communication with external stakeholders about controls, third-party control requirements are not communicated, incident notifications to customers are absent, or regulatory reporting is inadequate.

metadata.detection_notes: Review external communication policies, customer notification procedures, vendor management communications, regulatory reporting records, and stakeholder engagement documentation. Look for absence of external communications about controls, lack of incident notification processes, or inadequate stakeholder engagement.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC2 Communication and Information
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Fraud Risk Assessment
signals.description: The entity does not consider the potential for fraud in assessing risks to the achievement of objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when fraud risk assessments are not conducted, fraud scenarios are not identified, anti-fraud controls are not evaluated, or fraud prevention is not part of the risk management process.

metadata.detection_notes: Review fraud risk assessment documentation, fraud scenario analysis, anti-fraud control design, whistleblower procedures, and evidence of fraud considerations in risk assessments. Look for absence of fraud risk assessments, lack of fraud-specific controls, or no consideration of fraud in control design.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC3 Risk Assessment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: IT Governance Structure Missing
signals.description: The organization has not established a formal IT governance structure. This signal indicates the absence of defined oversight mechanisms for technology risk management and security decision-making as required by SOC 2 Common Criteria.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations providing technology services, Organizations requiring formal IT governance

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing governance documentation, examining board and committee structures, and verifying IT oversight mechanisms are in place.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC1 Control Environment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Incident Recovery
signals.description: The entity does not identify, develop, and implement activities to recover from identified security incidents.
signals.applicability: Recovery procedures, business continuity

metadata.detection_notes: Review incident recovery procedures, business continuity plans, disaster recovery processes, and recovery time objectives (RTOs). Verify recovery activities are documented and tested.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: Incident Resolution Process Missing
signals.description: The organization has not established a formal process for resolving security incidents. This signal indicates the absence of documented procedures for investigating, containing, and remediating security incidents.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations requiring incident management capabilities

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing incident response procedures, examining resolution workflows, and verifying that root cause analysis processes exist.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Incident Response Program
signals.description: The entity does not respond to identified security incidents by executing a defined incident-response program to understand, contain, remediate, and communicate security incidents, as appropriate.
signals.applicability: Incident response procedures, security operations

metadata.detection_notes: Review incident response plans, runbooks, and procedures. Verify incident response team exists, training is conducted, and tabletop exercises are performed. Check incident documentation and post-mortems.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Commitment to Integrity and Ethical Values
signals.canonical_name: No Commitment to Integrity and Ethical Values
signals.description: The entity does not demonstrate commitment to integrity and ethical values through conduct standards, performance evaluations, and corrective actions.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when leadership fails to establish, communicate, or enforce standards of conduct, ethical values are not integrated into hiring and evaluation processes, or remediation of misconduct is inadequate or inconsistent.

metadata.detection_notes: Review code of conduct policies, employee handbook acknowledgments, ethics training records, whistleblower procedures, disciplinary action records, and management tone-at-the-top communications. Look for absence of conduct standards, lack of ethics training, or inconsistent enforcement of policies.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC1 Control Environment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Internal Communication of Objectives
signals.description: The entity does not internally communicate information, including objectives and responsibilities for internal control, necessary to support the functioning of internal control.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when control objectives are not communicated to personnel, control responsibilities are not clearly articulated, communication channels are inadequate, or employees are unaware of their control duties.

metadata.detection_notes: Review internal communication policies, evidence of control objective communications, employee awareness surveys, training materials, and documentation of control responsibilities. Look for absence of internal communications about controls, low employee awareness, or lack of communication channels.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC2 Communication and Information
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Logical Access Security Software
signals.description: The entity does not implement logical access security software, infrastructure, and architectures over protected information assets to protect them from security events.
signals.applicability: All systems processing, storing, or transmitting protected data

metadata.detection_notes: Verify logical access security software is implemented through system configuration reviews, security architecture assessments, and access control testing. Check for presence of authentication systems, access control lists, and security monitoring tools.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Common Criteria
sources.section: CC1, CC2, CC3, CC4, CC5, CC6, CC7, CC8, CC9

sources.title: AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Malicious Software Prevention
signals.description: The entity does not implement controls to prevent or detect and act upon the introduction of unauthorized or malicious software.
signals.applicability: Endpoint protection, anti-malware systems

metadata.detection_notes: Review anti-malware solutions, endpoint protection platforms, malware detection capabilities, and incident response procedures for malware events. Verify regular updates and scanning operations.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Management Structure and Authority
signals.description: Management has not established structures, reporting lines, and appropriate authorities and responsibilities in pursuit of objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when organizational structure is undefined, reporting relationships are unclear, roles and responsibilities are not documented, authority levels are ambiguous, or there is inadequate segregation of duties.

metadata.detection_notes: Review organizational charts, role descriptions, delegation of authority policies, RACI matrices, and segregation of duties documentation. Look for absence of documented structure, conflicting authorities, or unclear accountability.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC1 Control Environment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Specification of Objectives
signals.description: The entity does not specify objectives with sufficient clarity to enable the identification and assessment of risks relating to objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when security, availability, confidentiality, privacy, or processing integrity objectives are not clearly defined, documented, or measurable.

metadata.detection_notes: Review strategic plans, security objectives documentation, service level objectives, risk management framework, and operational goals. Look for absence of documented objectives, vague or unmeasurable goals, or objectives that do not align with SOC 2 trust service criteria.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC3 Risk Assessment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Physical Access Restrictions
signals.description: The entity does not restrict physical access to facilities and protected information assets to authorized personnel.
signals.applicability: Data centers, server rooms, office facilities

metadata.detection_notes: Conduct physical security assessments, review access control systems for facilities, verify badge systems and visitor management processes. Inspect server rooms and data centers for physical access controls.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Deployment Through Policies
signals.description: The entity does not deploy control activities through policies that establish what is expected and procedures that put policies into action.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when policies do not exist, procedures are not documented, policies are not communicated or enforced, or there is a gap between policy and actual practice.

metadata.detection_notes: Review policy documentation, procedure manuals, evidence of policy communication and acknowledgment, policy enforcement mechanisms, and compliance monitoring. Look for absence of policies, lack of procedures, policies not followed in practice, or no evidence of policy enforcement.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC5 Control Activities
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Quality Information for Internal Control
signals.canonical_name: No Quality Information for Internal Control
signals.description: The entity does not obtain or generate and use relevant, quality information to support the functioning of internal control.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when information systems do not provide timely and accurate data, control monitoring lacks quality metrics, decision-making is not based on reliable information, or data quality processes are absent.

metadata.detection_notes: Review information system capabilities, data quality controls, reporting mechanisms, control dashboards, and evidence of data-driven decision making. Look for absence of control metrics, unreliable or outdated data, or decisions made without supporting information.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC2 Communication and Information
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Role-Based Access and Least Privilege
signals.canonical_name: No Role-Based Access and Least Privilege
signals.description: The entity does not authorize, modify, or remove access to data, software, functions, and other protected information assets based on roles, responsibilities, or the system design and changes.
signals.applicability: Access control systems, authorization processes

metadata.detection_notes: Review access control configurations, role definitions, and permission assignments. Test whether access is granted based on defined roles and responsibilities. Verify least privilege principle implementation.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Risk Identification and Analysis
signals.description: The entity does not identify risks to the achievement of its objectives and does not analyze risks as a basis for determining how risks should be managed.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when risk assessments are not performed, risks are not documented, risk analysis processes are absent, or risk management decisions are made without proper risk evaluation.

metadata.detection_notes: Review risk assessment documentation, risk registers, threat modeling exercises, risk analysis methodologies, and evidence of risk-based decision making. Look for absence of risk assessments, lack of risk documentation, or no evidence of systematic risk identification.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC3 Risk Assessment
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Risk Mitigation Activities
signals.description: The entity does not identify, select, and develop risk mitigation activities for risks arising from potential business disruptions.
signals.applicability: Business continuity planning, risk treatment

metadata.detection_notes: Review business continuity plans, disaster recovery procedures, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies. Verify risk mitigation activities are identified and implemented for business disruption scenarios.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC9 Risk Mitigation
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Secure Asset Disposal
signals.description: The entity does not discontinue logical and physical protections over physical assets only after the ability to read or recover data and software from those assets has been diminished.
signals.applicability: Hardware disposal, media sanitization

metadata.detection_notes: Review asset disposal procedures, media sanitization practices, and certificate of destruction documentation. Verify that data is securely erased before decommissioning hardware.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Technology General Controls
signals.description: The entity does not select and develop general control activities over technology to support the achievement of objectives.
signals.applicability: Applies to all entities when technology general controls (ITGC) are not designed or implemented, including controls over infrastructure, security management, change management, and operations.

metadata.detection_notes: Review ITGC documentation, change management procedures, access controls over infrastructure, backup and recovery controls, and technology operations controls. Look for absence of ITGCs, lack of change control, inadequate infrastructure security, or missing technology operations controls.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC5 Control Activities
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: Data Transmission Protection Missing
signals.description: The organization has not implemented adequate protection for data in transit. This signal indicates the absence of encryption or other security measures to protect data during transmission.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations transmitting sensitive data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing network configurations, checking for TLS/SSL implementation, and verifying encryption is used for sensitive data transmission.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Information Transmission Security
signals.description: The entity does not restrict the transmission, movement, and removal of information to authorized internal and external users and processes and does not protect it during transmission, movement, or removal.
signals.applicability: Data transfer, encryption in transit, data movement

metadata.detection_notes: Review data transmission mechanisms, encryption protocols (TLS/SSL), data transfer policies, and controls over data movement. Test whether data is protected during transmission across networks.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No User Registration and Authorization
signals.description: Prior to issuing system credentials and granting system access, the entity does not register and authorize new internal and external users.
signals.applicability: Identity and access management processes

metadata.detection_notes: Review user provisioning processes, access request workflows, and approval documentation. Verify that user registration and authorization procedures exist before credential issuance.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: User Access Removal Process Missing
signals.description: The organization has not established a formal process for removing user access when no longer needed. This signal indicates the absence of procedures for timely revocation of access rights upon termination or role change.
signals.applicability: Organizations pursuing SOC 2 certification, Service organizations with user access management requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection involves reviewing access removal procedures, examining termination checklists, and verifying that access revocation is timely and complete.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC6 Logical and Physical Access Controls
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Vendor and Partner Risk Management
signals.canonical_name: No Vendor and Partner Risk Management
signals.description: The entity does not assess and manage risks associated with vendors and business partners.
signals.applicability: Third-party risk management, vendor assessments

metadata.detection_notes: Review vendor risk management program, third-party assessments, due diligence procedures, and ongoing vendor monitoring. Verify vendor contracts include security requirements and vendor performance is monitored.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC9 Risk Mitigation
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Vulnerability Detection and Monitoring
signals.description: The entity does not use detection and monitoring procedures to identify changes to configurations that result in the introduction of new vulnerabilities and susceptibilities to newly discovered vulnerabilities.
signals.applicability: Vulnerability scanning, configuration monitoring

metadata.detection_notes: Review vulnerability scanning processes, patch management procedures, configuration monitoring tools, and vulnerability assessment reports. Verify regular vulnerability scans and remediation tracking.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - CC7 System Operations
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
COSO Internal Control - Integrated Framework

signals.name: No Confidential Information Identification
signals.description: The entity does not identify and maintain confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
signals.applicability: Data classification, information inventory

metadata.detection_notes: Review data classification policies, information inventory, data labeling schemes, and confidentiality definitions. Check for absence of classification framework, unlabeled sensitive data, or unclear confidentiality criteria.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Confidentiality
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Confidential Information Disposal
signals.description: The entity does not dispose of confidential information to meet the entity's objectives related to confidentiality.
signals.applicability: Secure data destruction, retention policies

metadata.detection_notes: Review data disposal policies, secure deletion procedures, media sanitization processes, and retention schedules. Check for absence of disposal procedures, insecure deletion methods, or retention policy violations.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Confidentiality
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Input and Output Storage Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Input and Output Storage Controls
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures to store inputs, items in processing, and outputs completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with system specifications.
signals.applicability: Data storage, archival processes

metadata.detection_notes: Review data storage policies, archival procedures, retention controls, storage validation processes, and data integrity checks. Check for absence of storage controls, retention policies, or data integrity verification.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Input Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Input Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures over system inputs, including controls over completeness and accuracy.
signals.applicability: Input validation, data quality controls

metadata.detection_notes: Review input validation logic, data quality checks, error handling for invalid inputs, and validation policies. Check for absence of input controls, validation rules, or completeness checks.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Output Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.canonical_name: No Output Completeness and Accuracy Controls
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures to make available or deliver output completely, accurately, and timely in accordance with specifications.
signals.applicability: Output validation, reporting accuracy

metadata.detection_notes: Review output validation controls, report generation procedures, data export processes, output reconciliation, and delivery mechanisms. Check for absence of output validation, completeness checks, or accuracy verification before delivery.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Processing Policies and Procedures
signals.description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's product or service specifications.
signals.applicability: Data processing controls, batch processing

metadata.detection_notes: Review data processing procedures, transformation logic, quality controls during processing, reconciliation processes, and error handling. Check for absence of processing controls, validation during processing, or quality assurance measures.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Processing Specifications
signals.description: The entity does not obtain or generate, use, and communicate quality information regarding the objectives related to processing, including definitions of data processed and product and service specifications.
signals.applicability: Data processing documentation, service specifications

metadata.detection_notes: Review data processing documentation, service level agreements, data dictionaries, processing specifications, and quality standards. Check for absence of documented processing objectives, data definitions, or quality criteria.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Processing Integrity
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Access Denial Notification
signals.description: The entity does not inform data subjects if access to their personal information is denied and provides the reason for denial. This signal indicates that individuals are not adequately notified when their access requests are rejected, which undermines transparency and privacy rights.
signals.applicability: Applicable to data subject access request workflows, customer service procedures, self-service portals, and any system or process that may deny access to personal information.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of access request procedures, denial notification templates, customer service scripts, and workflow automation. May be identified by absence of denial notification mechanisms, missing reason documentation, or incomplete response procedures.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Privacy
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
AICPA Generally Accepted Privacy Principles (GAPP)

signals.name: No Data Breach Notification
signals.description: The entity does not notify affected data subjects, regulators, and others when a data breach has occurred in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. This signal indicates that critical breach notification obligations may not be met, potentially violating legal requirements and undermining trust.
signals.applicability: Applicable to breach response procedures, notification workflows, regulatory compliance processes, incident management systems, and communication protocols for data breaches.

metadata.detection_notes: Commonly detected through review of breach notification procedures, incident response plans, regulatory compliance documentation, and notification tracking systems. May be identified by absence of notification workflows, missing breach communication plans, or lack of regulatory reporting procedures.

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Privacy
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
AICPA Generally Accepted Privacy Principles (GAPP)

signals.name: No Communication of Choices
signals.description: The entity does not communicate choices available regarding the collection, use, retention, disclosure, and disposal of personal information to data subjects.
signals.applicability: Consent mechanisms, preference centers

metadata.detection_notes: Verify presence and clarity of mechanisms for data subjects to understand and exercise choices regarding their personal information

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Privacy
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination
AICPA Generally Accepted Privacy Principles (GAPP)

signals.name: No Collection Limitation
signals.description: The entity does not limit the collection of personal information to that which is necessary to meet its objectives.
signals.applicability: Data minimization, collection practices

metadata.detection_notes: Review data collection forms, APIs, and processes to ensure only necessary information is collected for stated purposes

sources.title: AICPA Trust Services Criteria - Privacy
AICPA SOC 2 Reporting on an Examination

signals.name: No Privacy Compliance Monitoring
